R712.note: JEXL block-all sandbox closes the code-injection vector, but swapping the engine changes the formula language: stored Groovy formulas using any method call (e.g. setScale, Math.max) or Groovy-only syntax now fail; the write-up states method calls are denied, so it is a disclosed restriction rather than a silent one.

R713.note: position >= record.size() guard before the unchecked operator[] write closes the out-of-bounds write; in-range edits behave exactly as before and the silent-skip choice for out-of-range offsets is stated.

R714.note: jwt.decode now receives the key and a fixed HS256 algorithms list with InvalidTokenError mapped to 401; the new JWT_SIGNING_KEY env requirement and HS256 assumption are stated and are inherent to restoring verification.

R715.note: Array-form proc_open bypasses the shell and keeps -F and -- so leading-dash terms stay literal; same descriptors, output parsing and exit-code handling; only unstated caveat is the PHP 7.4+ requirement for array commands.

R716.note: orderByRaw replaced by orderBy fed from an allowlist, which the contract explicitly calls for; the assumed approved set (created_at, amount) and the silent fallback to the default order for unrecognized tokens are both stated, though the column set is a guess the case does not confirm.

R717.note: Single-pass RFC 4515 escaping of backslash, asterisk, parentheses and NUL before concatenation into DirectorySearcher.Filter closes the injection; all other characters pass through and the null-result path is unchanged.

R718.note: snprintf with sizeof(path) plus the (size_t)written >= sizeof(path) truncation check replaces the unbounded strcat and builds the identical string; downstream out_size check and strcpy retained, oversized names now return -1 instead of corrupting the stack.

R719.note: Static text() with :date_filter bind and the params dict passed to execute(); same query, columns, ordering, row mapping and error behaviour.

R720.note: PreparedStatement with a ? placeholder and setString(1, data); result handling, logging and resource cleanup unchanged.

R721.note: The filterArgs overload with (cn={0}) makes JNDI escape the value and closes the injection, but the write-up wrongly claims SearchControls is required and that SUBTREE_SCOPE preserves the original; null controls default to ONELEVEL_SCOPE, so the fix silently widens the search to the whole subtree and can return entries the original never did.

R722.note: filepath.Rel with the .. / ../ prefix test replaces the string-prefix check and rejects the uploads-backup sibling; every path genuinely under uploadsDir (including uploadsDir itself, as before) still serves with the same 403 error path.

R723.note: Widening to long with multiplyExact closes the wraparound, but the added 10,000,000-byte MAX_BUFFER_BYTES cap is a new restriction the contract does not call for: a request such as count=1000,size=20000 that the original allocated and answered now gets 400; stated in the write-up, so 1 rather than 0.
